title: CATL restarts Jianxiawo lithium mine, uncertainty remains
author: Luc Braun, Matthew Bird
text:
CATL has rapidly recommenced activities at its Jianxiawo lithium mine following the acceptance of its revised environmental impact assessment of 30 October. 

Satellite imagery from 19 November analysed by Benchmark confirms activities consistent with a resumption of some mining activities. This is in addition to a re-activation of beneficiation activities at the mine’s associated flotation plant. 

Imagery also shows continued use of tailings facilities at the heart of the years-long saga around the mine’s resumption of activities following its mining license conversion in November 2025 following its previous lithium byproduct license expiry in summer 2025.
